command: <native PowerShell> -Command 'rg --files --hidden; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath inputs -File | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Name; Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Encoding UTF8 }'
<native PowerShell> -Command 'rg --files --hidden; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath inputs -File | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Name; Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Encoding UTF8 }'

tool_error_excerpt: | The term 'python' is not recognized as a name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or executable program.

command:
<native PowerShell> -Command '$ErrorActionPreference = '"'Stop'
"'$utf = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
$binary = [Text.Encoding]::Latin1
$base = (Get-Location).Path
function Read-Bytes($name) { ,([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path $base $name))) }
function Write-Bytes($name, [byte[]]$bytes) { [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes((Join-Path $base $name), $bytes) }
function Read-Json($name) { $utf.GetString((Read-Bytes $name)).TrimStart([char]0xfeff) | ConvertFrom-Json -Depth 99 -AsHashtable }
function Write-Json($name, $data) { Write-Bytes "outputs/$name" ($utf.GetBytes((ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $data -Depth 99) + "`n")) }
function Only($items) { if (@($items).Count -ne 1) { throw '"'Expected exactly one target' }; "'$items }
function Replace-Match($source, $match, $value) {
  $group = $match.Groups['"'value']
  "'$source.Substring(0, $group.Index) + $value + $source.Substring($group.Index + $group.Length)
}
function Require($condition, $message) { if (!$condition) { throw $message } }
$originals = @{}
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath inputs -File | ForEach-Object { $originals[$_.Name] = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName).Hash }
$directive = Read-Json '"'inputs/release_directive.json'
"'$paths = @('"'steps/01_parsed_directive.json','steps/02_price_applied.json','steps/03_release_applied.json','steps/04_email_applied.json')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'outputs/steps','outputs/bundle' | Out-Null
Write-Json "'$paths[0] ([ordered]@{
  directive_id = $directive.directive_id
  release_time_new = $directive.release_time.new_value
  applied_price_changes = @($directive.price_change | Where-Object status -CEQ '"'apply' | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ product_id = "'$_.product_id; new_value = $_.new_value } })
  excluded_price_changes = @($directive.price_change | Where-Object status -CNE '"'apply' | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{ product_id = "'$_.product_id; reason = $_.status } })
  support_email_new = $directive.support_email.new_value
})
$parsed = Read-Json "outputs/$($paths[0])"
$catalog = Read-Json '"'inputs/catalog.json'
"'$authorized = Only ($parsed.applied_price_changes | Where-Object product_id -CEQ '"'P-A')
"'$product = Only ($catalog.products | Where-Object id -CEQ '"'P-A')
Write-Json "'$paths[1] ([ordered]@{ path = '"'catalog.json'; field = 'products[P-A].price_cents'; old = "'$product.price_cents; new = $authorized.new_value })

$announcement = $binary.GetString((Read-Bytes '"'inputs/announcement.md'))
"'$prefix = $binary.GetString($utf.GetBytes('"'正式发布：'))
"'$announcementPattern = '"'(?m)"'^'"' + [regex]::Escape("'$prefix) + '"'(?<value>["'^'"\\r\\n]+)\\r?"'$'"'
"'$releaseMatch = Only ([regex]::Matches($announcement, $announcementPattern))
Write-Json $paths[2] ([ordered]@{ path = '"'announcement.md'; field = 'release_time'; old = "'$releaseMatch.Groups['"'value'].Value; new = "'$parsed.release_time_new })

$contacts = $binary.GetString((Read-Bytes '"'inputs/contacts.csv'))
"'$emailPattern = '"'(?m)"'^support,(?<value>[''^,'"\\r\\n]+),'
"'$emailMatch = Only ([regex]::Matches($contacts, $emailPattern))
Write-Json $paths[3] ([ordered]@{ path = '"'contacts.csv'; field = 'support.email'; old = "'$emailMatch.Groups['"'value'].Value; new = "'$parsed.support_email_new })

$price = Read-Json "outputs/$($paths[1])"
$release = Read-Json "outputs/$($paths[2])"
$email = Read-Json "outputs/$($paths[3])"
Write-Bytes '"'outputs/bundle/announcement.md' ("'$binary.GetBytes((Replace-Match $announcement $releaseMatch $release.new)))
$product.price_cents = $price.new
Write-Json '"'bundle/catalog.json' "'$catalog
Write-Bytes '"'outputs/bundle/contacts.csv' ("'$binary.GetBytes((Replace-Match $contacts $emailMatch $email.new)))
Write-Bytes '"'outputs/bundle/protected.txt' (Read-Bytes 'inputs/protected.txt')
Write-Json 'change_log.json' ([ordered]@{ changes = @("'$release, $price, $email); steps_index = [ordered]@{ steps = $paths } })

$finalAnnouncement = $binary.GetString((Read-Bytes '"'outputs/bundle/announcement.md'))
"'$finalContacts = $binary.GetString((Read-Bytes '"'outputs/bundle/contacts.csv'))
foreach ("'$check in @(@($finalAnnouncement,$announcementPattern,$release,$announcement), @($finalContacts,$emailPattern,$email,$contacts))) {
  $match = Only ([regex]::Matches($check[0], $check[1]))
  Require ($match.Groups['"'value'].Value -ceq "'$check[2].new) '"'Final value differs from step'
  Require ((Replace-Match "'$check[0] $match $check[2].old) -ceq $check[3]) '"'Unauthorized byte changes'
}
"'$finalCatalog = Read-Json '"'outputs/bundle/catalog.json'
"'$finalProduct = Only ($finalCatalog.products | Where-Object id -CEQ '"'P-A')
Require ("'$finalProduct.price_cents -eq $price.new -and $price.old -is [ValueType] -and $price.new -is [ValueType]) '"'Price mismatch'
"'$finalProduct.price_cents = $price.old
Require ((ConvertTo-Json $finalCatalog -Depth 99 -Compress) -ceq (ConvertTo-Json (Read-Json '"'inputs/catalog.json') -Depth 99 -Compress)) 'Unauthorized catalog changes'
Require ((Get-FileHash outputs/bundle/protected.txt).Hash -ceq "'$originals['"'protected.txt']) 'Protected file mismatch'
foreach ("'$name in $originals.Keys) { Require ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath "inputs/$name").Hash -ceq $originals[$name]) '"'Input modified' }
"'$log = Read-Json '"'outputs/change_log.json'
Require (("'$log.steps_index.steps -join '"'|') -ceq ("'$paths -join '"'|')) 'Step index mismatch'
Require ((ConvertTo-Json -InputObject "'$log.changes -Depth 99 -Compress) -ceq (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($release,$price,$email) -Depth 99 -Compress)) '"'Log mismatch'
Require ("'$parsed.excluded_price_changes[0].reason -ceq ($directive.price_change | Where-Object product_id -CEQ '"'P-B').status) 'Excluded reason mismatch'
Require (@(Get-ChildItem outputs -Recurse -File).Count -eq 9) 'Unexpected delivery file count'
Get-ChildItem outputs -Recurse -File -Name"
